title: True Beauty
hook: How does True Beauty end? Ju-kyung's love triangle, Se-yeon's tragedy, and the two-year time jump in the Season 1 finale, explained.

sections.heading: The love triangle finally resolves
sections.body: True Beauty spends its run balancing Lim Ju-kyung between two boys, the quiet Lee Su-ho and the warmer Han Seo-jun. The finale settles it cleanly. Ju-kyung ends up with Su-ho, and Seo-jun gives up his feelings for her rather than force the contest any further. The series frames it not as a defeat but as a release, letting Seo-jun step back so the relationship that grew through shared honesty can stand on its own. Through every up and down, Su-ho and Ju-kyung support each other and grow stronger together, and they find happiness in one another.

sections.heading: The shadow of Se-yeon's death
sections.body: Beneath the romance sits a heavier thread that the ending finally confronts. Jung Se-yeon was a boy-group member signed under Su-ho's father's entertainment company, and he became a victim of harsh online shaming and fabricated scandals. The pressure drove him to take his own life by jumping from a tall building. The finale has Su-ho uncover the horrible truth behind the fake scandals that pushed Se-yeon to suicide, turning his long-held grief and guilt into something he can finally name and face rather than carry silently.

sections.heading: Su-ho's father owns the truth
sections.body: The reckoning extends to the adult world that allowed the tragedy. Su-ho's father steps down from his position after revealing to the public the truth about Se-yeon's death and about a plagiarised song tied to the same scandals. It is a deliberate act of accountability rather than a quiet exit, putting the real story on record so the lie that destroyed Se-yeon cannot keep standing. For Su-ho, his father's public admission helps close the wound that had defined his guarded, withdrawn nature for most of the series.

sections.heading: Two years later, back where it started
sections.body: The finale jumps forward two years to show where everyone has landed. Ju-kyung is working as a makeup assistant, building the career her skill with cosmetics always pointed toward, while Seo-jun pursues his singing ambitions. Su-ho and Ju-kyung, separated by time and circumstance, reunite. The series ends by returning to its own origin point, with the two sharing a kiss at Prince Comics, the shop where they first met over a shared love of a webtoon. The closing image ties the grown-up reunion back to the awkward teenagers they began as.

final_image: Su-ho and Ju-kyung share a kiss at Prince Comics, the comic shop where they first met, the two-year time jump bringing the story full circle to where their connection began.

lingering_questions.q: Who does Ju-kyung end up with?
lingering_questions.a: Lee Su-ho. Han Seo-jun gives up his feelings for her, and Su-ho and Ju-kyung, having supported each other through the series, reunite after a two-year time jump and find happiness together.

lingering_questions.q: What was the truth about Se-yeon?
lingering_questions.a: Se-yeon was a boy-group member who died by suicide after harsh online shaming and fake scandals. Su-ho uncovers the truth, and his father publicly reveals it and the plagiarised song before stepping down.
